name: 北门（海南中學牌坊）
frame: Twin frame. x across the gate (campus east +), y along the axis (+ towards the street), z up from the road (0).

evidence.hero: assets/images/web/hero-2560.jpg: frontal view from the street. Camera recovered from the scene: level (horizon row 1075 from the converging kerbs), principal column 1280, f ~2036 px, eye 1.52 m, about 13.8 m in front of the gate face. Gate-plane scale 6.78 mm/px; elements in front of the gate (lions) at ~12.5 m: 6.14 mm/px.
evidence.osm: campus boundary vertex on the axis at y 105.7 (OpenStreetMap via Overture 2026-11-18.0); the gate is placed with its centre plane at y = 106.0 on the axis. The 0.4 m parallax between the gate centre and the Teaching Block 1 portal on hero-2560 is within the uncertainty.
evidence.landscape_intro: assets/images/campus/landscape_intro.jpg: same gate, slightly wider, confirms bay rhythm, lions, walls

basis: All heights and widths measured on hero-2560 in the gate plane (focal-length independent ratios checked against ground-contact back-projection); depth (front-back) of piers and roofs is not visible and is estimated.

central_bay.text_note: displayed left to right as 學中南海, read right to left as 海南中學

central.basis: eave board bottom row 200 px (7.45 m), ridge row 76 px (8.3 m), eave span 10.8 m in the photo reduced for the eaves' projection towards the camera

side.basis: eave row 476 px (5.6 m), ridge row 370 px (6.3 m), outer eave about 1.3 m beyond the outer pier

lions.basis: four white stone lions on square pedestals in front of the piers (hero-2560: pedestal top 0.94 m, lion top 2.04 m); carving simplified

walls.basis: line of the OSM campus boundary; white rendered wall with green glazed-tile coping and a notice board east of the gate (left edge of hero-2560); height estimated

gatehouse.basis: white building with a green-tiled hip roof west of the gate (right edge of hero-2560, camera facing south); footprint estimated

booth.basis: guard booth and turnstiles in the west side opening (right-hand opening seen from the street, hero-2560)

open_questions: Gate depth (piers and roofs front to back) and the south face are not photographed; the south face repeats the north face with a blank plaque (invented).
Exact position along the axis rests on the OSM boundary (y 105.7); the photo puts the camera 13.8 m in front of the gate, which is consistent but not independent.
